Superscript Three Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Superscript Three is 0179. Hold Alt, type 0179 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Superscript Three also has the Unicode codepoint U+00B3, so you can type it with Alt+179 on Windows, search for U+00B3 in macOS's Character Viewer, use ³ in HTML, or \00B3 in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. Copy the Superscript Three character from this page when you need it in a form, chat message or document that does not accept Alt codes. HTML also defines the named entity ³ for Superscript Three, but the numeric form ³ is safer when compatibility is uncertain.

How to type superscript three on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 0 1 7 9 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Superscript Three character (³) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type superscript three on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Superscript Three. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Superscript Three" and click the character to insert it.

How to use superscript three in code

  • HTML: or , also
  • CSS: content:"\00B3"; ()
  • Python: \u00B3 or chr(0xB3)
  • JavaScript: \u00B3 or String.fromCodePoint(0xB3)
  • JSON: "\u00B3"
  • LaTeX: $^3$ (math mode)

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Superscript Three?

The legacy Alt code for Superscript Three is 0179. Hold Alt, type 0 1 7 9 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type ³ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ³, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+179 not work?

Alt+179 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Superscript Three?

The Unicode codepoint for Superscript Three is U+00B3. You can use this value in HTML as ³, in CSS as \00B3, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ³ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+00B3, then click it.
